alt: Pink galah cockatoo (rose-breasted cockatoo) perched on a branch, the species chosen as Brisbane 2032 Olympic emblem
story: Brisbane 2032 Olympics organizers accidentally published their elaborate logo-reveal video on their own YouTube channel on Friday, ruining a months-long PR build-up — the emblem is a pink galah cockatoo, which in Australian slang means 'a fool'.
why_funny: They chose a bird that Australians call a fool as their emblem, then immediately proved the point by fouling up their own reveal — the logo picked perfectly.
